add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

spec2def(dmusic.dll dmusic.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(dmusic registry dmusic.idl)

# dmusic.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dmusic-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dmusic_shims OBJECT band.c buffer.c clock.c collection.c dmobject.c dmusic.c dmusic_main.c download.c instrument.c port.c wave.c)
target_link_libraries(dmusic_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libole32 libadvapi32 libwinmm libdsound libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dmusic_shims)
add_dependencies(dmusic_shims wineheaders)
set(DMUSIC_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmusic/dmusic_r.o)
add_cargo_module(dmusic dmusic-cargo dmusic.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dmusic_shims psdk dmusic_r ${DMUSIC_REUSED} uuid_sources)
